description: Search Spotify podcasts or episodes, export a show's full episode archive, or resolve show and episode links. No Spotify account, client ID or API key is required.

episodeIds.description: Spotify episode IDs, spotify:episode: URIs or open.spotify.com/episode/ links. Used by mode=getEpisode.
episodeIds.title: Episode IDs or links

includeDetails.description: Fetch complete show or episode metadata for every search result, including descriptions, ratings, topics, release times, paywall flags and preview audio. Turn off for a faster, lighter search.
includeDetails.title: Fetch full details

includeEpisodes.description: When mode=getShow, also export the show's episode archive. Turn off to export only the show record.
includeEpisodes.title: Include episodes when fetching a show

maxItems.description: Maximum number of show and episode records to save. Search modes have a source ceiling of about 1,000 matching results.
maxItems.title: Max records

enumTitles: Get a show and its episodes by ID or link
Get episodes by ID or link
mode.title: Mode

releasedAfter.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. Episodes older than this are skipped. In getShow mode, paging stops once the archive passes this date.
releasedAfter.title: Released after

releasedBefore.description: Optional YYYY-MM-DD date. Episodes newer than this are skipped.
releasedBefore.title: Released before

searchQuery.description: Keyword to search for in the selected search mode, for example 'true crime', 'daily news' or a host name.
searchQuery.title: Search query

showIds.description: Spotify show IDs, spotify:show: URIs or open.spotify.com/show/ links. Used by mode=getShow.
showIds.title: Show IDs or links

startUrls.description: Mixed show and episode links. Show links are read when mode=getShow, episode links when mode=getEpisode. Regional /intl-xx/ links and embed links are accepted.
startUrls.title: Start URLs

title: Spotify Podcast Show & Episode Metadata Input
